oracle_definition: apply_op(o, {'op': 'RELIEVE', 'a': X, 'b': Y}) does o.deps[X].discard(Y): it un-binds the CURRENT directional edge X->Y. It touches nothing else: no formed/proposition state, no scars, no time, no decision change.
notes: The oracle keeps no depot of old edges; reconstructibility comes from the op stream / the adapter's dependency_ledger. RELIEVE is asymmetric: X stops depending on Y, but Y's dependence on X (if declared) is untouched.
